name: Qanet: Night Prayer Companion
description:
The night prayer app for Muslims. Track your Qiyam, stay consistent and build the habit the Prophet called the honor of the believer — Be a Qanet, one night at a time.

The Prophet PBUH said: "If anyone prays at night reciting regularly ten verses, he will not be recorded among the negligent; if anyone prays at night and recites a hundred verses, he will be recorded among those who are obedient to Allah (Qanet); and if anyone prays at night reciting one thousand verses, he will be recorded among those who receive huge rewards (Muqantar)."

Qanet is built around this timeless guidance. Reaching the Qanet level — just 100 verses — takes as little as 5 to 10 minutes. The goal isn't perfection.
